decide.sql: SELECT thinkthen_decide('{"decide":"Is this a complaint?"}', 'i want a refund now');

decide_plain.sql: SELECT thinkthen_decide('Is this a complaint?', 'i want a refund now');

batch_context.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM thinkthen_decide_many('{"decide":"Is this a complaint?"}', '{"a":"refund one","b":"refund two"}'::jsonb, '{"context":"Use this policy note."}'::json);

probability.sql: SELECT probability FROM thinkthen_decide_many('{"decide":"Is this a complaint?"}', '{"a":"i want a refund now"}'::jsonb);

choose.sql: SELECT thinkthen_choose('{"choose":"Which team handles this?","options":["the refund desk","other desk"]}', 'refund now', NULL);

choose_native_plain.sql: SELECT thinkthen_choose('Which team handles this?', 'refund now', ARRAY['the refund desk','other desk']);

score.sql: SELECT thinkthen_score('{"score":"How strong is the refund claim?","levels":["low","mid","high"]}', 'maybe later', NULL);

tag.sql: SELECT array_to_string(thinkthen_tag('{"tag":"What is in this text?","labels":["refund","shipping"]}', 'the refund and the shipping', NULL), ',');

find_empty.sql: SELECT thinkthen_find('Which passage answers?', ARRAY[]::text[]) IS NULL;

details.sql: SELECT jsonb_array_length(thinkthen_details('{"decide":"Is this a complaint?"}', 'i want a refund now')->'meta'->'requests');

usage.sql: SELECT requests_sent, cache_answers, input_tokens, output_tokens FROM thinkthen_usage();

recognize.sql: SELECT n.text, n.kind FROM (VALUES ('Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.')) AS v(body), LATERAL thinkthen_recognize(v.body, ARRAY['person','organization','place']) n ORDER BY n."start";

relations.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM thinkthen_relations('Maria Chen joined Northwind Freight in Chicago last spring.', '@names.json');

setup: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alerts(id integer primary key, body text)

INSERT INTO alerts VALUES (1,'Checkout returns 500 at the payment step.'),(2,'Card charges are failing for every customer.'),(3,'The nightly export ran two hours late.'),(4,'The payments database ran out of disk space.')
relate.sql: SELECT relation, source, target, probability FROM thinkthen_relate('SELECT id, body FROM alerts', ARRAY['caused_by']) WHERE source = 1 ORDER BY target;

decide_many.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM thinkthen_decide_many('{"decide":"Is this a complaint?"}', '{"a":"refund now","b":"refund again"}'::jsonb);
